page.layout: One printed page of verse in one column, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature at bottom left and right of the last line.

main_text.p: Quantas perpetuis cogit opes lucris, Quum telas Tyrius sindonibus pares, Et quae pinxit acu mollia nobili Diuendu pretijs carbasa grandibus.
Hinc mentem trepidis intrepidam gerit Rebus: non dubij temporis exitum, Casúsve ancipites, aut pauet anxia Quae ventura dies durior apparat.
Illi verba fluunt pectore candido Semper mellifluis picta leporibus: Et puram loquitur quae sapientiam Spirent, quaeque nitens gratia temperet.
Aedes mane suas sollicitis vigil Lustrat luminibus, singula dispicit, Vt se quisque gerat, sordibus & procul Vt cunctis niteat munda domus, cauet.
Nusquam cessat iners: pane laboribus Quaesito variis vescitur impigra. Prudens nil sterili pigritia putat Peius, nilve gula deside turpius.
Talem magnificis certat honoribus Matrem progenies splendida tollere: Et dignum meritis cogitat illius Tantis obsequium reddere protinus.

page.notes: Printed "Ut" appears as "Vt" in the original and is kept as printed. "Diuendu" is read as printed; the final abbreviation mark is uncertain. The poem is in roman type with no italics or marginal notes. Show-through from the other side of the leaf is visible at the right and faint text at the upper left; it is not transcribed.
